PROPOSED PROJECTS
Airport Spur
This proposed project is still in the planning stages. It still needs some required approvals before the twelve families and five businesses would be required to move. This project is adjacent to the subject project. Of the twelve families affected by this project, only six are presently owners. The displacement should not take place during the same time period. If by chance it should, the availability and turnover would be sufficient to handle both projects.
Lake Freeway
Originally these project segments were to displace approximately 349 individuals or families. Actual displacement however will not occur within the time period of displacement for the subject project due to various requirements yet to be met, namely, environmental statements and development of a housing program.
Stadium Freeway
Approximately 97 families are believed to be potentially affected in this project area. These displacees, as those on the Lake Freeway, will not be required to move during the period of displacement on this project.
Maitland Park
This park project will involve 3 families but will be acquired at a later date, yet to be established.
Belt Freeway
This project is in preliminary planning with no acquisition, except hardship cases, planned until possibly 1975.
